# HEIC fixture

`example.heic` is the libheif project's example file, downloaded from:
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/master/examples/example.heic

Used only to verify HEIC decoding in tests. The libheif project's licensing information is at https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/master/COPYING . It is not a customer photo and is never deployed as website content.
